title: Enable shared environment inheritance coverage on Windows
description:
The shared environment-inheritance regression is excluded from Windows because its uv probe uses a Python shebang. This leaves worker and resolver inheritance, environment restoration after restart, and Console's cache and temporary-directory adjustments outside the shared Windows coverage.

Replace the probe launcher with a native executable and enable the existing regression on Windows. Preserve its four inheritance combinations and its direct and sandbox assertions. Other Unix fixture exclusions in SP-3 remain separate work.

title: Run shared runtime discovery tests on Windows
description:
The gated runtime-discovery tests in SP-3 of `docs/TODO.md` use a shebang R probe, `fork()`, and FIFOs. Windows skips these public startup, cancellation, failure, and restart cases because of their fixtures.

Replace the probe with a native executable and a portable blocking gate. Preserve the descendant-retirement assertions, complete diagnostics, and shared snapshots. Keep pipe-backpressure, R FIFO, and native-interposition cases on their applicable platforms.

title: Make inherited-procfs namespace denial coverage deterministic
description:
The inherited-procfs sandbox regression currently expects `network_setns: errno:22`, but Linux 6.8 hosts report `errno:13` while opening the namespace file, before `setns()` runs. This is tracked as SP-5 in `docs/TODO.md`.

Make the disposable fixture establish a deterministic namespace-access boundary. Preserve the fresh/inherited procfs matrix, exact errors, filesystem and network policy checks, and host/supervisor isolation assertions. Identify the source of the differing denial stage rather than accepting multiple errors or normalizing them away.
